input.prompt: Image 1 is a simple cross section drawing of a small cellar under a kitchen, seen from the side. Image 2 is a photo of the kitchen above it: cream lime walls, a carved stone sink with a brass tap, wooden cabinets, soft daylight. Make a real photograph standing in that same kitchen, looking down through the open trapdoor in the stone floor: the door sized wooden lid stands open, and one straight wooden staircase with a wooden handrail along the wall goes down into the cellar, lit warm from below by one lamp; the stone floor at the bottom and the edge of a wooden shelf with jars just visible. Same kitchen materials and soft daylight as image 2. The cellar has only: a door sized wooden trapdoor in the kitchen floor, lifted open; one straight wooden staircase of about twelve steps with a wooden handrail along one wall; a room of standing height, about 2.2 meters, with a level stone floor and plain lime plaster walls; one warm light; sturdy wooden shelves on two walls holding glass jars of fruit and vegetables, sacks of rice and beans, and big glass water jugs. One straight staircase, no other stairs, no labels, no other rooms, no people. No other buildings, no barns, no sheds. Real photograph, Kodak Portra 400 look, natural true colors, soft fine grain, real camera optics. No text, no letters, no signs, no labels, no logos, no watermark anywhere.
